method: cross-check exact-source archaeology and restoration receipts in janus-meta-registry

sheet_audit.evidence: Exact historical source Mj/mod_hive_nexus.py SHA256 5226ae44...; early LAN swarm protocol has no authentication, signatures, replay prevention, payload limits or device authorization; executable source is not published as current runtime.

Historical path J\mod_indus.py is anchored by indexing log, but standalone exact bytes remain unrecovered. Embedded Indus behavior in ai_engine_merged_ascii.py creates repair-job JSON; delete/kill/rewrite/apply-patch behavior was not observed.

mod_scavenger.py is present in ONE3 static code architecture index. A separate exact service_scavenger.py lineage performed broad recursive scanning and is intentionally absorbed into scoped provenance-first ingestion; name-equivalence must not be assumed.
No exact standalone mod_bloodhound.py source anchor was recovered from the inspected GitHub archaeology in this pass. Search negative is not proof of nonexistence.

Hippocampus capability appears in historical ai_engine/blood_core families and an exact hippocampus source digest exists in early archaeology, but this pass did not establish that the spreadsheet's standalone mod_hippocampus.py/version label is the same byte lineage.

Historical Antivik Wikipedia ingestion behavior is recovered in text, but raw byte SHA256 for mod_antivik.py was unavailable; related mod_antivik_beetle.py MD5 anchor exists and equivalence is explicitly NOT_ESTABLISHED. Destructive source deletion is forbidden in the modern route.

archive_security_controls.rule: Secret-bearing or syntax-invalid historical files are evidence artifacts, not current working modules.

conclusion.next_action: Build a canonical module ledger keyed by exact path + SHA256 + source family + safe capability + modern route + authority class, then replace simple green/version cells with evidence classes.
